field.name: com_tjucm_trustinitialplan_LabelOverview
field.label: Label: Overview
field.freetext:
The initial trust plan is used to support the completion of the accountability framework. 

Ideally we like to meet termly with the trust data protection lead.  We can work with you to help write a data protection report for the Trust Board, based on meetings, visits and Knowledge Bank data from the current academic year.

If you would like to know more or need more support please email:  dpo@dataprotection.education for a member of the team to get back to you.
